description: One program this alumnus completed. A person may complete several, so this is a row rather than a field on the profile.

fields.description: The school's own year identifier, as everywhere else in the app. Free-form text ("2017-2018"), which is why the class year beside it is a separate number.
fields.label: Academic Year

fields.description: "Class of" — derived from the academic year's end, not from the calendar year of the conclusion date. An autumn graduate of 2017-2018 is Class of 2018, and taking .year off their December conclusion date called them 2017.
fields.label: Class Year

fields.description: The enrollment this graduation came from. Blank for an alumnus recorded by import rather than by graduating here.
fields.label: Program Enrollment

name: Alumni Graduation
